title: Review Desk Training Note: Information Extension of the Bridge (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
**Rule.** For an emergency supply under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the information extension of the bridge counts the information requests on the drug's coverage review cases under the Utilization Management Program that have no matching receipt of information:

- with two or more outstanding, it is twice the review program's information-request wait in days;
- with exactly one outstanding, it is the review program's information-request wait in days;
- with none, it is zero days.

## Training questions

**What is "outstanding"?** The number of information requests recorded on the coverage review cases for the drug, less the number of receipts of information recorded on those cases.

**Where does the wait figure come from?** It is the information-request wait in days set by the member's Utilization Management Program, not a figure of the retail network.

**A drug's review cases show three information requests and one receipt. What is the extension, if the review program's wait is 14 days (hypothetical)?** Two are outstanding, so the extension is twice 14, that is 28 days.

**Four requests and one receipt, same wait?** Three are outstanding; two or more gives twice the wait, so still 28 days — never three times.

**Two requests and one receipt?** Exactly one is outstanding: 14 days.

**Two requests and two receipts?** None is outstanding: zero days.

**Do requests on another drug's review case count?** No. Only the coverage review cases for the drug of the bridge are counted.
